from pathlib import Path
import shutil, sys

print("python:", sys.version.split()[0])
inp = Path("/kaggle/input")
print("input children:", sorted(p.name for p in inp.iterdir()) if inp.is_dir() else "MISSING")
mats = sorted(inp.rglob("*.mat"))
print("n_mat:", len(mats))
for m in mats[:2]:
    print("  first:", m.relative_to(inp), m.stat().st_size)
for m in mats[-2:]:
    print("  last :", m.relative_to(inp), m.stat().st_size)
print("total GiB:", round(sum(m.stat().st_size for m in mats) / 2**30, 3))
print("working free GiB:", round(shutil.disk_usage("/kaggle/working").free / 2**30, 2))

import torch
print("torch", torch.__version__, "cuda", torch.cuda.is_available())
if torch.cuda.is_available():
    print("device", torch.cuda.get_device_name(0), torch.cuda.get_device_capability(0))

if mats:
    from scipy.io import loadmat
    d = loadmat(str(mats[0]), variable_names=["emg", "restimulus"], squeeze_me=False)
    print("emg", d["emg"].shape, d["emg"].dtype)
